title: Azurestone Order
wikitext:
The '''Azurestone Order''' is an ancient order of [[dwarven]] mages. Founded long ago when the very caves of [[Ironforge]] were being mined, they had come across the [[Azurestone]], an old and magically potent stone through which many of the first dwarven mages had gotten their footing within the realm of arcana.<ref>[[Tholdan Mountainheart#Quotes]]</ref>
